ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, SUPPRESS through the context functions since #51 (assumed): in splitByValue emptyValue, SUPPRESS is not ""; the SUPPRESS comes from createIf, true for 1 or true and SUPPRESS for 0 or false, in any case, and anything else ends the run with po:CREATEIF (ADR-0006 amended, F-37; fn/createIf/002); observation #61
note: createIf gives "", SUPPRESS, "", SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS in one context. emptyValue cuts at each "" and drops it: (empty) | SUPPRESS | SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS, so collapseContexts gives three empty All. SUPPRESS taken for "" gives six.
